segments.ja90:4.1: Apāyimha ca dūbhakaṃ sattapadaṃ, chaḷadvara ca āyatinā ca puna;
segments.ja90:4.3: Ahisīlava maṅgali pāpikassā, sataṃnikkha katatthavarena dasāti.

lines: Tatrāyaṃ piṇḍattho – khattiyādīsu yo koci puriso pubbe paṭhamataraṃ aññena katakalyāṇo katūpakāro katattho nipphāditakicco hutvā taṃ parena attani kataṃ kalyāṇañceva atthañca na jānāti, so pacchā attano kicce samuppanne tassa kiccassa kattāraṃ nādhigacchati na labhatīti.
